description_en: Queries a list of gateways and returns their IDs and names
description_zh: 查询网关列表信息。包括网关ID，网关名称等
kebab_example: aliyun sgw describe-gateways --storage-bundle-id sb-0001b2otnkdxrigeq000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --resource-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeGateways

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the gateway cluster.

If you do not specify ResourceRegionId, you must specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
网关集群ID。

如果不指定 ResourceRegionId，则必须指定该参数
parameters.name: storage_bundle_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the gateway list.

Start value: 1.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
网关列表信息的页码。

起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 50.
Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the resource resides
parameters.name: resource_region_id

Code.description_en: The status code. A status code of 200 indicates that the request was successful
Code.description_zh: 状态码。状态码为200表示请求成功

ActivatedTime.description_en: The activation time. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds

BuyURL.description_en: The purchase URL. This parameter is returned only for subscription gateways
BuyURL.description_zh: 付费类型为包年包月时，返回购买链接

CommonBuyInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance in the sales system. This parameter is returned only for subscription gateways
CommonBuyInstanceId.description_zh: 付费类型为包年包月时，在售卖系统中的实例ID

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the gateway was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
CreatedTime.description_zh: 网关创建时间。时间戳为秒（s）

EcsInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the ECS instance

ExpireStatus.description_en:
The expiration status of the gateway. Valid values:

0: Normal.
1: The gateway is about to expire.
2: The gateway has expired
ExpireStatus.description_zh:
网关是否过期状态。可能值：

0：正常。

1：将要过期。

2：已经过期

ExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds

GatewayClass.description_en:
The gateway class. Valid values:

Basic: Basic.
Standard: Medium.
Enhanced: Enhanced.
Advanced: Performance
GatewayClass.description_zh:
网关规格。可能值：
Basic：基础型。

Standard：标准型。

Enhanced：增强型。

Advanced：性能型

GatewayType.description_en:
The type of the gateway

File: file gateway
Iscsi: iSCSI gateway
GatewayType.description_zh:
网关类型

File：文件网关

Iscsi：块网关

HighAvailability.description_en:
Indicates whether the gateway is a cross-zone high availability (HA) gateway. The return values are as follows:

true: The gateway is a cross-zone HA gateway.
false: The gateway is not a cross-zone HA gateway
HighAvailability.description_zh:
是否为跨可用区高可用网关，返回值如下：
true：是跨可用区高可用网关。
false：不是跨可用区高可用网关

IsPostPaid.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

true: pay-as-you-go.
false: subscription
IsPostPaid.description_zh:
付费类型。可能值：

true：按量付费，即后付费。

false：包年包月，即预付费

IsReleaseAfterExpiration.description_en:
Indicates whether the subscription gateway is released after it expires. Valid values:

true: The gateway is released after it expires. The service of the Cloud Storage Gateway is stopped seven days after the gateway expires.
false: The gateway is converted to a pay-as-you-go gateway after it expires
IsReleaseAfterExpiration.description_zh:
当付费类型为包年包月时，网关是否到期释放。可能值：

true：到期释放，直接收回。创建的云存储网关到期7天后，停止云存储网关服务。

false：创建的云存储网关到期后，转按量付费模式

Location.description_en:
The location of the gateway. Valid values:

Cloud: a gateway deployed on Alibaba Cloud.
On_Premise: a gateway deployed in a data center
Location.description_zh:
网关位置。可能值：

Cloud：线上网关。

On_Premise：线下网关

PublicNetworkBandwidth.description_en: The public bandwidth for data transmission. Unit: Mbit/s. This parameter is supported only by gateways deployed on Alibaba Cloud
PublicNetworkBandwidth.description_zh: 数据公网带宽，单位为Mbps。仅线上网关支持

SecondaryVSwitchId.description_en: The ID of the vSwitch. This parameter is supported only by HA gateways
SecondaryVSwitchId.description_zh: 虚拟交换机vSwitch ID。仅高可用网关支持

Status.description_en:
The status of the gateway. Valid values:

Initialized: The gateway is initialized.
Deactivated: The gateway is not activated.
Activated: The gateway is activated.
Deploying: The gateway is being deployed.
Running: The gateway is running.
Stopping: The gateway is being stopped.
Stopped: The gateway is stopped.
Starting: The gateway is being started.
Rebooting: The gateway is being restarted.
Deleting: The gateway is being deleted.
Failed: The gateway failed to run.
Upgrading: The gateway is being upgraded.
Modifying: The gateway is being modified.
Unknown: No heartbeat is detected for a long time
Status.description_zh:
网关状态。可能值：

Initialized：已初始化。

Deactivated：未激活。

Activated：已激活。

Deploying：部署中。

Running：运行中。

Stopping：停止中。

Stopped：已停止。

Starting：启动中。

Rebooting：重启中。

Deleting：删除中。

Failed：失败。

Upgrading：升级中。

Modifying：修改中。

Unknown：长时间没有心跳

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC)

Message.description_en: The description of the request result

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the gateway list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page in the gateway list

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of gateways in the specified gateway cluster
TotalCount.description_zh: 指定网关集群ID下的网关总数
